Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical factual error in Step 5 by misinterpreting the search results. The search results explicitly stated that Charles A. Allen was the "city engineer of Worcester" (a source of confusion for the Planner). However, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the engineer was the "city engineer of Springfield" and that this linked the bridge to Hampden County. This was a hallucination; the search results did not support the claim that Allen was the Springfield engineer. This error led the entire subsequent conversation down the wrong path, causing the team to waste steps trying to verify a false premise (Springfield/Hampden) instead of confirming the correct one (Worcester/Worcester County).
